namespace = omni_items

# Event-based character inventory menu. Opened by the Items button on the
# character window (omni_character_items_button scripted GUI). Root scope is the
# character whose window is open. Each list event shows one option per item,
# gated so only relevant items appear.

### HUB
omni_items.1 = {
	type = character_event
	picture = war_chest
	title = omni_items.1.t
	desc = omni_items.1.desc
	left_portrait = root

	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.equip
		trigger = { has_any_item = yes }
		trigger_event = { id = omni_items.2 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.unequip
		trigger = {
			has_variable_list = equiped_item_list
			any_in_list = { variable = equiped_item_list count >= 1 }
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_items.3 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.buy
		trigger = {
			omni_character_has_local_market = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = omni_recent_purchase_cooldown }
		}
		clear_variable_list = omni_item_shop_stock
		remove_variable = omni_item_shop_open
		remove_variable = omni_market_quality
		trigger_event = { id = omni_items.6 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.equip_artifact
		trigger = {
			is_ruler = yes
			employer = {
				OR = {
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:Cyrogley_crown_of_eagalia }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_axe_of_Fiorinoes }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_Dunydurcerg_royal_scale }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_krak_diadem }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_spear_krak }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_Shield_krak }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_grom_axe }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_lech_cape }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_ros_bow }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_zehia_horse_saddle }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_martyr }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_wolf_tooth }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_eternity_shield }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_invisible_ring }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_flame_chalice }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_agony_band }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_fire_fleece }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_mending_cloak }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_primal_maul }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_arcane_doomblade }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_dragon_blade }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_sword_rebels }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_nuvians_robe_orcanite }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_sword_of_artheousan }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_ascendic_diadem }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_ring_of_feelings }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_hobgob_droitra_dagger }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_kinone_bowl_of_plenty }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_sword_of_the_victory_goddess }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_helm_of_the_mother_warrior }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:treasure_roldalls_shield }
					any_country_treasure = { THIS = treasure:iron_crown_of_herue }
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_artifacts.1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.unequip_artifact
		trigger = {
			is_ruler = yes
			OR = {
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_Cyrogley_crown_of_eagalia }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_axe_of_Fiorinoes }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_Dunydurcerg_royal_scale }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_krak_diadem }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_spear_krak }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_Shield_krak }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_grom_axe }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_lech_cape }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_ros_bow }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_zehia_horse_saddle }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_martyr }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_wolf_tooth }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_eternity_shield }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_invisible_ring }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_flame_chalice }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_agony_band }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_fire_fleece }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_mending_cloak }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_primal_maul }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_arcane_doomblade }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_dragon_blade }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_sword_rebels }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_nuvians_robe_orcanite }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_sword_of_artheousan }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_ascendic_diadem }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_ring_of_feelings }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_hobgob_droitra_dagger }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_kinone_bowl_of_plenty }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_sword_of_the_victory_goddess }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_helm_of_the_mother_warrior }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_treasure_roldalls_shield }
				has_item = { item_ID = item_artifact_iron_crown_of_herue }
			}
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_artifacts.2 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.sell
		trigger = {
			has_any_item = yes
			omni_character_has_local_market = yes
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_items.5 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.discard
		trigger = { has_any_item = yes }
		trigger_event = { id = omni_items.4 }
	}
	option = {
		name = omni_items.1.close
	}
}

### omni_items.2

		name = item_chainmail
		trigger = {
			has_item = { item_ID = item_chainmail }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = equiped_item_list target = flag:item_chainmail } }
			has_any_other_same_category_item_equipped = { item_category = armour item_ID = item_chainmail amount_per_category = 1 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = item_chainmail_desc

		hidden_effect = {
			root.location = { save_scope_as = omni_item_market_province }
			root.country = {
				create_character = {
					age = 35
					save_scope_as = omni_item_merchant
				}
			}
